pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches are irregular polygons with rounded vertices. Patches on the lower hindquarters are smaller and approximately equilateral, while patches on the mid-flank and neck are significantly larger and elongated along the dorsoventral axis.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-colored inter-patch pathways. The network is characterized by primarily tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively consistent across the visible flank, narrowing slightly at the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of short, dense bristles against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep, dark linear gash or puncture is visible on the upper mid-flank. This anomaly exhibits a sharp textural void and deep shadow, indicating a significant physical indentation in the hide.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, small, dark circular focal point is present near the base of the tail, distinct from the geometric boundaries of the standard patch pattern.
